descriptionHtml:
Car is located in Lithuania, near Kaunas. Feel free to message at any time, calls from 8:00 - 22:00. I speak Lithuanian, English.

RARE RWD 2022 Year BMW M440i coupe with full and exclusive equipment. Printed carfax history will be provided for potential buyer. Current mileage: 38000 km.

Exterior:
Rare Dravitgrau Metallic (fully repainted, not a single bruise or other damage). Full M Aerodynamics package with aggresive front styling, side skirts, rear diffuser, spoiler. Enhanced with Maxton design accents and full shadowline exterior. Equipped with red M sport brakes and larger discs, 20 inch wheels with new tyres, sunroof, tailgate which opens and closes with feet, illuminated original welcome lights “wings” under side sills when unlocking the car.

Interior & Comfort:
Black Vernasca leather with contrast grey stitching, heated and ventilated seats with lumbar support (a rare feature on the M440i). Black headliner, multi-color ambient lighting, heated M leather steering wheel, remote engine start for pre-heating/cooling, and Comfort Access keyless entry.

Performance & Engine:
Powered by the renowned B58D 3.0L inline-6 turbo (285 kW / 388 hp). Includes M Sport Differential, Adaptive M Suspension, Variable Sport Steering, and a fast-shifting 8‑speed Sport Automatic. The sport exhaust system features adjustable valves – quiet in Comfort mode, loud and crackling in Sport+.

Technology & Multimedia:
BMW Live Cockpit Professional with fully digital cluster and large central display, Head-Up Display, Harman/Kardon surround sound, wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, built‑in Drive Recorder (dashcam function), gesture control, and enhanced Bluetooth/Comfort Telephony.

Safety & Assistance:
Equipped with Driving Assistant & Active Guard (lane, blind spot, and collision systems), adaptive cruise control with stop & go, Parking Assistant Plus with 360° cameras, 3D camera, car wash camera, front camera. Laserlight headlights with auto high-beam, and Active Protection (seatbelt and window pre-tension in collisions). Seatbelt handover after door close, retracts when drive over.

Why it stands out:
Motorsport Engineering Package, US-spec model with Hot/Cold Climate tuning, ventilated seats, full M package, RWD!!!, laserlights, and Dravitgrau Metallic – a rare combination close to an M4 in feel but with more daily comfort.
Perfectly maintained, oil and filters replaced at 35,000 km, mechanically flawless, fully ready for a new owner.
